description: This PHP file defines the BuildCommands class within the SuiteCRM project. It includes commands for compiling themes and color schemes related to SuiteP, involving file operations, executing build commands, and directory traversal. It serves as a command-line utility extension for theme management in SuiteCRM.

classes.name: BuildCommands
classes.description: A class extending Robo Tasks providing commands to build and compile SuiteCRM themes and color schemes.

methods.name: buildTheme
methods.description: Compiles a specified theme's SASS files into CSS, optionally handling multiple color schemes or subthemes.

methods.name: buildSuiteP
methods.description: Builds the SuiteP default theme with optional color scheme.

methods.name: buildColorScheme
methods.description: Executes the command to compile a specific color scheme SASS file into CSS.

methods.name: locateSubTheme
methods.description: Searches a directory for subthemes with style.scss files, recompiling them if style.css exists or needs regeneration.
